customer_name: Guangdong Provincial Government Services and Data Administration (广东省政务服务和数据管理局)
business_problem: Guangdong needed to replace slow, manual, and fragmented investment-attraction processes with a digital service that could match enterprises to resources and explain frequently changing policies more accurately and at lower operating cost.
solution_summary: Guangdong's government services and data administration department worked with Baidu AI Cloud to build the 'Investment Guangdong' AI assistant as a province-level investment-attraction service. The solution refactored Baidu's UNIT dialogue platform with Wenxin large-model capabilities, then integrated large volumes of structured resource data covering parks, factories, office buildings, projects, land parcels, and events alongside unstructured policy documents. Qianfan-based summarization and generation improved the system's understanding of colloquial business questions, while a shared knowledge layer let the assistant perform precise matching against招商 resources and natural-language Q&A over policy text. In the Heyuan pilot, the team fine-tuned the model on local full-volume resource and policy data, enabling a single assistant to answer investor questions, summarize policy content, and return targeted resource recommendations without forcing citizens or enterprises to search across many disconnected systems.

solution_components.name: Qianfan Large Model Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the summarization and generation capabilities that improve policy understanding and investor question answering.

solution_components.name: UNIT Intelligent Dialogue Platform
solution_components.role: Serves as the conversational foundation that was rebuilt and upgraded for the province-level investment assistant.

solution_components.name: Investment Guangdong AI Assistant
solution_components.role: Delivers investor-facing consultation, resource matching, and policy interpretation services.

solution_components.name: Resource and Policy Knowledge Base
solution_components.role: Stores structured investment resources and unstructured policy content so the assistant can return grounded matches and answers.

data_flow: Structured data about parks, factories, buildings, land parcels, projects, and events is combined with policy documents inside the shared knowledge base. Investor questions enter through the dialogue platform, Qianfan interprets colloquial intent and policy text, and the assistant returns either matched investment resources or generated policy explanations for Guangdong and pilot city scenarios.
business_outcome: The province gained a scalable digital investment-attraction assistant that speeds consultation, improves policy interpretation, lowers service cost, and gives Guangdong a reusable public-sector large-model pattern for future digital-government services.
metrics: The Heyuan pilot was trained and launched within 2 months.
architecture_clues: The implementation combines structured investment-resource matching with unstructured policy-document Q&A and summarization.
The assistant was built as a province-level service and then fine-tuned on full-volume local data for a pilot city.
The system is intended to support citizens and enterprises asking policy and resource questions in natural language.
evidence_quotes: The department and Baidu built the country's first province-level investment-attraction AI assistant (original: 广东省政数局联合百度智能云打造全国首个省级招商引资AI助手).
The assistant rebuilt Baidu UNIT with Wenxin large-model capabilities and integrated massive resource and policy data (original: 依托百度文心大模型，对百度UNIT智能对话平台进行重构升级，集成广东省海量资源与政策数据).

It can answer precise questions over structured investment resources and perform natural-language Q&A and generation over unstructured policy documents (original: 具备招商资源结构化数据的精准匹配问答；具备招商政策文本文档非结构化数据的自然语言问答和生成).
The Heyuan pilot completed model training and launch within two months and currently achieves more than 90% inquiry accuracy (original: 2个月内完成了模型训练和上线…现阶段问询准确率达90%以上).
